description: Compute a Beats work-proof — cryptographic evidence of computational effort by this agent. Computes sequential hash chains at the current network difficulty, submits to the Beats service for a signed receipt. The receipt can be used for spawn authorization and other operations.

count.description: Number of beats to compute (min 10, max 10000)

difficulty.description: Hash iterations per beat (default 1000, min 100, max 5000). Usually auto-detected from network.

name: provenonce_beats_proof
title: Compute Beats Work-Proof
